notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.content: There are now 13 Achievements in Shadow Walker! Nobody in the whole world has beat them all... will you be the first?

notes.title: Shadow Walker Release Date!
notes.content:
Shadow Walker is a top down game, inspired by hits like Spelunky or Brotatoe, where the point of the game is to fight enemies and eventually kill the Shadow Boss!

The release date for this game? 

[b]January 31, 2025[/b]

Wishlist to be notified!
